messages:
Maya (Growth): Heads up — planning a hybrid search + retarget push around the webinar next Tue. Need paid setup + creative refresh. Low-risk test: geo-target West Coast. Thoughts?

James (Paid): SGTM. Budget idea: $6k over 7 days, pacing frontloaded to catch registration spike. Retarget pool = 30d site visitors + webinar landing viewers.

Lina (Content): I'll draft 3 headline variations + 2 hero images. Want copy aligned to the 'reduce inference cost' angle. Will share drafts by EOD.

Oliver (RevOps): Routing note — leads from the webinar form should go to SF SDR queue when utm_campaign=webinar-q2. Others go to general inbound. I can add HubSpot workflow for that.

Emi (Demand Gen): UTMs proposed: utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc, utm_campaign=webinar-q2, utm_content=creativeA. Also add hidden field 'lead_source' on the form so we can map ad sets.

James (Paid): For search: exact + phrase keywords around 'low latency llm api', 'inference cost per token'. 4 ad groups. Bid strategy: maximize conversions with target CPA $65 for first 48h, then switch to manual if CPA > $80.

Maya (Growth): @James can we cap daily spend ramp to avoid early overspend? want even pacing until 24h before the webinar.

James (Paid): I'll set pacing rule: day1_cap = 0.15 * total_budget, then 25% day2, ramp to 100% by day4. Also create automation: pause creative if CTR < 0.5% after 12h.

Lina (Content): Drafts ready — Headline A: 'Reduce your LLM inference costs by up to 3x' 
Headline B: 'Predictable, low-latency LLM inference' 
Headline C: 'Ship LLM features with 99.9% uptime' 
Images: hero-1_gpu_farm.png, hero-2_console_dashboard.png. Will upload assets to the ad asset library.

Maya (Growth): For retargeting: frequency cap = 3/day, window = 14d, rotation optimized for highest CTR. Exclude converters and people who visited pricing in last 7d.

ads-bot: Campaign pre-check: creative sizes OK. Landing page mobile load = 1.9s (good). Form missing hidden field 'lead_source' — flagged.

Oliver (RevOps): Adding the hidden field and mapping utm_term -> keyword in HubSpot. Also will create SF queue mapping: if company_size > 250 then tag as 'high-value' and route to enterprise SDRs.

Emi (Demand Gen): I'll wire the webhook to Marketo for registration events and add a notify to #growth-live for high-value leads. Also will set a filter for company_size>250 to trigger Slack ping.

James (Paid): Tracking template to use: {lpurl}?utm_source=google&utm_campaign=webinar-q2&utm_content={adid}&gclid={gclid}  — will apply at campaign level.

Maya (Growth): Timeline: creative freeze by 9 AM Mon, ad groups + keywords built by noon Mon, first ad review 3 PM Mon, go-live Tue 8 AM PST. Smoke test Tue 7:30 AM. Any blockers?

Lina (Content): No blockers. Uploading Figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder (public link).

Emi (Demand Gen): Will run a 2-hour smoke test Tue 7:30 to verify lead flow and hidden field.

James (Paid): I'll enable automated pacing rules and monitor the first 6 hours — will post hourly updates to this thread.

Maya (Growth): :thumbsup: Let's execute. Thanks team!
